Subject: Pilot acceptance checkpoints & testing methods — recap and options

Hi Sofia —

Thanks again for the conversation earlier. Quick recap and the options we discussed so the whole team is aligned:

Summary of requirements (from your notes):
- 1,000 daily clinical-note summarizations (avg. 220 tokens output) to start; potential ramp to 5k/day in month 2.
- Data residency: US-only (customer-managed keys).
- Latency target: p50 < 450ms for single-document summarization flows; occasional batch jobs ok for background processes.
- Success criteria: 85% of summaries rated >= 4/5 on clinical accuracy rubric; <2% hallucination rate on a labeled sample.

Proposed pilot acceptance checkpoints (high level):
1) Shadow run (online, non-prod traffic) — 1 week, 1000 docs/day, graded by your clinical SMEs using a shared rubric.
2) Offline batch evaluation — 500 labeled examples (clinically adjudicated) to compute accuracy/hallucination metrics.
3) Ramp / soak — 1 week at 2–3k/day with cost telemetry and latency SLO verification.

Two evaluation methodologies to choose between (we discussed pros/cons):
A) Shadow-first: Run our model in shadow mode against live traffic; you get real behavior and latency. Faster to validate integration but requires SME tagging during the week.
B) Offline-first: Run the batch labeled set through multiple model variants and quantization configs to identify the best candidate before shadowing. Cleaner statistical signal but takes longer to create labels.

Attached: pilot_acceptance_checklist.docx and scoring_rubric_v1.xlsx (first pass). Also linking the drive folder where we’ll collect SME labels and shared dashboards.

Next steps / asks:
- Sofia: confirm whether you prefer A (shadow-first) or B (offline-first) so we can finalize timeline.
- Healthly: point of contact for SME grading (name + availability).
- Marissa/Neha: once Sofia confirms, can you draft a 3-week pilot schedule and assign owners for data access, KMS setup, and scoring?

I’ll sync with Engineering on the estimated Dedicated capacity and can provide a cost estimate for the shadow week vs. offline runs.

Thanks —
Rafael
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Thanks Rafael — good recap and thanks for pulling the rubric together.

We discussed this internally with our clinical lead (Dr. Patel) and product ops. Our lean preference is B) Offline-first for the discovery phase. Rationale: we need clean, adjudicated labels to compare variants (especially given clinical risk). If the offline numbers look good, we’ll greenlight a short shadow week to validate latency and integration.

SME grading contact: Dr. Neel Patel (neel.patel@healthly.ai) — 2–3 hours/day available between Feb 23–27 for initial labeling. He’d like a short guide for what constitutes a 4 vs 5 on the rubric — can your team draft that?

We also request an initial run of three model configs: base-16bit, int8-quantized, and the low-latency variant you mentioned. Can you confirm whether the quantized variant will require any special infra?

Regards,
Sofia
Head of Product | Healthly.ai

- Feb 23–27: SME adjudication window (Dr. Patel) — we’ll send an annotation guide and short training call on Feb 22.
- Mar 1–5: Shadow validation (if offline metrics meet acceptance). One week of shadow traffic at ~1k/day.

Owners: 
- Data transfer + KMS: Neha Kapoor (neha_kapoor@redwood.ai) — she’ll reach out to your infra lead for key wrap and test artifacts.
- Scoring / rubric questions: Marissa Cole (marissa_cole@redwood.ai).
- Pilot orchestration / scheduling: Rafael Mendes.

Quantization note: int8 quantized variant will run on the same Dedicated infra but may require a slightly different runtime toggle; no special hardware required from your side. We’ll handle the runtime config and provide a checklist for verifying numeric parity. Expect a small difference in tokens-per-second on the low-latency variant.

Attachments: trial-schedule-v2.pdf (draft timeline). I’ll update scoring_rubric_v1.xlsx based on Dr. Patel’s guidance after your training call.

Marissa / Neha — can you pick up the owners' action items and confirm by EOD tomorrow?

Thanks,
Rafael
